notes: Freeze a provider adapter before live execution. It must accept the complete prompt on stdin, emit durable provider JSONL on stdout, start a fresh non-persistent session, expose only arm-approved tools, disable ambient skills/hooks/MCPs, and never perform network access except provider API traffic. Stage the adapter and every tool it pins OUTSIDE /Users/: policy.ts treats a /Users/ path in any tool event as a critical violation, and agents embed resolved absolute paths in later commands, so a /Users/ pin turns correct behaviour into a policy failure. If the adapter spawns an MCP server, spawn it in its own process group and tear the group down on process exit and on SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP rather than on session_end, which never fires in print mode, and clear any request watchdog timers so the process does not linger after the agent finishes. Pass credentials only through credential_environment_variables.
